question: What are the library hours?
answer: The John B. Coleman Library is typically open Monday through Thursday from 7:00 AM to 12:00 AM, Friday from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sunday from 2:00 PM to 12:00 AM. Students can access study spaces, computers, and research support during these hours. Hours may vary during holidays or exam periods. For the most current schedule, visit: https://www.pvamu.edu/library/about-the-library/hours-2/

question: What time does the library close?
answer: The John B. Coleman Library closing time depends on the day of the week. It is typically open Monday through Thursday until 12:00 AM, Friday until 6:00 PM, Saturday until 6:00 PM, and Sunday until 12:00 AM. Hours may vary during holidays, special events, or exam periods. For updated hours, visit: https://www.pvamu.edu/library/about-the-library/hours-2/
